SELECT NVL(SUM(p.total_price),0) FROM PAYMENTS p LEFT JOIN ROOM_RESERVATION rr ON p.resort_reserv_id = rr.resort_reserv_id LEFT JOIN ROOM R ON r.room_id = rr.room_id WHERE r.resort_id = #{resortID} AND rr.status != '예약취소'
AND p.created_at BETWEEN #{atStart} AND #{atEnd}

SELECT r.room_type AS category, SUM(NVL(p.total_price, 0)) AS total_sales FROM ROOM_RESERVATION rr JOIN ROOM r ON rr.room_id = r.room_id JOIN PAYMENTS p ON p.resort_reserv_id = rr.resort_reserv_id
AND r.resort_id = #{resortID}
AND p.created_at BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{atStart}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{atEnd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
GROUP BY r.room_type ORDER BY total_sales DESC

SELECT NVL(count(*),0) FROM PAYMENTS p LEFT JOIN ROOM_RESERVATION rr ON p.resort_reserv_id = rr.resort_reserv_id LEFT JOIN ROOM R ON r.room_id = rr.room_id WHERE r.resort_id = #{resortID} AND rr.status = '예약완료'
AND p.created_at BETWEEN #{atStart} AND #{atEnd}

SELECT NVL(count(*),0) FROM PAYMENTS p LEFT JOIN ROOM_RESERVATION rr ON p.resort_reserv_id = rr.resort_reserv_id LEFT JOIN ROOM R ON r.room_id = rr.room_id WHERE r.resort_id = #{resortID} AND rr.status = '예약취소'
AND p.created_at BETWEEN #{atStart} AND #{atEnd}

SELECT TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'MM/DD') AS salesDate, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(p.total_price) AS amount FROM PAYMENTS p JOIN ROOM_RESERVATION rr ON p.resort_reserv_id = rr.resort_reserv_id LEFT JOIN ROOM R ON r.room_id = rr.room_id WHERE r.resort_id = #{resortID} AND p.created_at BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{atStart}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{atEnd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'MM/DD') ORDER BY salesDate
